answer_1.quote: We present a long-term dialogue framework, EPISODE, which summarizes persona information and personal events and extracts shared memories from dialogues. Then, the framework incorporates them into response generation for long-term dialogue.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics. To assess the quality of the generated responses for each session, we conduct an automatic evaluation using a comprehensive set of metrics, including BLEU-3/4, ROUGE (ROUGE-1/2/L), BERTscore, Distinct-1/2 (Dist) and PPL.

answer_3.quote: To verify that using shared memory makes long-term dialogues more engaging, we further conduct a GPT-4o assisted evaluation based on the following criteria: Coherence (Coh.), Engagingness (Eng.), Closeness (Clo.), Reflectiveness (Ref.).

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations through Amazon Mechanical Turk(AMT) to highlight the differences between SHARE and SHARE (w/o shared memory).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated based on Closeness, Engagingness, and Coherence.
